FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Senior Divisional Finance Manager, Mumbai Central, Western Railway A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of works Hiring of One SUV four wheel Vehicle assigned for Commercial Control, period of 36 months on a 24 hour basis with two drivers deployed in t

wo shifts to ensure uninterrupted availability of the vehicle on all seve n days of the week 1. Governing Documents The contract shall be governed primarily by the General Conditions of Contract (GCC) for Services, 2018, including all applicable correction slips, amendments and Railway Board instructions issued from time to time. The GeM Contract/SLA, Letter of Acceptance (LOA), Special Conditions of Contract (SCC), this Scope of Work and written instructions issued by the Railway Administration shall form in tegral parts of the contract. 2. Nature and Period of Service The work consists of hiring one vehicle of Maruti Suzuki Ertiga/Mahindra XUV/Sc orpio or equivalent/same or higher segment, complete with driver, for a period of 03 years assigned to Commercial Control, Mumbai Central. The vehicle shall be deployed as directed by Sr DCM/BCT or the authorized Railway official. 3. Place of Deployment The vehicle shall normally be based at DRM Office, Mumbai Central. The contrac tor shall not claim additional payment merely on account of change in reporting location within the normal area of operation. 4. Duty Hours and Reporting: The vehicle shall be made available to the Railway Administration on a 24- hour basis, with two drivers deployed in two shifts, to ensure uninterr upted availability of the vehicle on all seven days of the week. The nor mal duty hours shall be from 08:00 hrs to 20:00 hrs, with the second shift coveri ng the remaining period, i.e. 20:00 hrs to 08:00 hrs. The vehicle shall be made available on all days, including Sundays and holidays, The weekly rest of the drivers shall be managed independently by th e successful bidder at their own cost and arrangement, by providing suitable rel ievers/substitute drivers, without affecting the uninterrupted availability of the vehicle or causing any additional financial liability to the Railway Administration. The reporting time, release time and reporting location may be changed accordi ng to the operational requirements of the Railway Administration. Any requirem ent beyond the stipulated normal duty hours arising from emergencies, acciden ts, unusual occurrences, inspections or other official exigencies shall be dealt wi th strictly as per the GeM Contract/SLA and applicable contractual payment pro visions.

5. Official Use and Area of Operation The vehicle shall be used for movement at stations, goods sheds, freight termin als, sidings, Railway establishments, work sites, adjoining areas and other locati ons as required by the officers. It may be required during inspections, accidents , emergencies, unusual occurrences, special drives and other exigencies. The v ehicle may ply on kutcha roads, approach roads, Railway service roads, goods s heds and roads adjoining Railway installations wherever legally and physically p ermissible. No extra claim shall be entertained solely due to road conditions. 6. Monthly Kilometre Limit and Additional Kilometres The monthly hiring charges shall cover operation up to 2000 km per month. An y kilometers beyond 2000 km in a month shall be payable strictly at the rate an d under the conditions stipulated in the GeM Contract/SLA. No payment shall be admissible for unauthorised/private use of the vehicle. Outstation duty hours-24 x7 as per GeM contract/SLA. 7. Vehicle Category, Age and Condition The vehicle shall be Toyota Innova Crysta/Maruti Ciaz/ Maruti Suzuki Ertiga/Mahi ndra XUV 700/Scorpio, Kia Carens or equivalent/same or higher segment as acc epted under the applicable GeM category. It shall be commercially/tourist regist ered, roadworthy, properly maintained and fit for continuous official operation. The vehicle shall not be more than two years old on the date of initial deployme nt. It shall remain in good physical and mechanical condition throughout the co ntract period and shall be free from defects affecting safety, reliability or appea rance. Document related to purchase year of the vehicle shall be produced on d emand. 8. Statutory Documents and Permits The contractor shall maintain valid Registration Certificate, insurance, fitness ce rtificate, permit, Pollution Under Control Certificate, road tax and all other statut ory documents required under applicable law. The vehicle shall possess valid au thorization/permit for operation in Maharashtra, Gujarat and any other State/are a where official duty requires movement, wherever legally necessary. All relate d costs shall be borne by the contractor. 9. Driver The contractor shall provide an experienced, skilled, medically and physically fit drivers possessing a valid and appropriate driving license & Police verification. The driver shall be conversant with Mumbai, Gujarat and adjoining areas and m ajor Railway locations, and shall be capable of using navigation facilities where

required. Driver deployed should preferably be from local area of Mumbai centr al or nearby for uninterrupted service. The driver shall maintain discipline, court esy and proper behaviour and shall not operate the vehicle under the influence of alcohol, narcotic or intoxicating substances. 10. Driver Uniform, Mobile and Conduct The driver shall wear a neat and presentable uniform consisting of white/sky-blu e shirt and navy-blue/black trousers, or such other uniform as approved by Rail way Administration shall be provided by bidder on his own cost. A working mobi le phone shall be available and the driver shall remain reachable while on duty. The driver shall not use a mobile phone while driving except through legally per missible hands-free/emergency arrangements. 11. Fuel, Maintenance and All-Inclusive Expenses The contractor shall bear all expenses necessary for uninterrupted operation an d proper upkeep of the vehicle, including fuel, lubricants, driver wages, statutor y payments, servicing, repairs, tyres, batteries, insurance, permits, taxes, toll c harges, parking charges, FASTag charges and required accessories viz, curtains , air fresheners, tissue papers etc. No additional payment shall be admissible ex cept where specifically provided in the GeM Contract/SLA. 12. Cleanliness and Safety The vehicle shall be maintained in clean, neat and presentable condition at all ti mes. Interior and exterior shall be cleaned daily and seat covers/towels shall be maintained in clean condition. Deep cleaning/wash shall be done regularly once in a month. The vehicle shall have a serviceable spare wheel, jack, wheel spann er, first-aid box, fire extinguisher and all other mandatory safety equipment. Lig hts, indicators, horn, brakes, tyres, wipers, speedometer, odometer and other s afety-related equipment shall remain functional. 13. Odometer and Instrument Integrity The odometer, speedometer and other meters/instruments shall remain functio nal and accurate. Any tampering with the odometer or other vehicle instrument shall be treated as a serious breach of contract and shall invite action under the applicable contractual provisions. 14. Breakdown and Replacement Vehicle In case of breakdown, accident, mechanical failure, defect or inability of the veh icle to perform duty, the contractor shall provide a suitable replacement vehicle of the same or higher category, in good condition, at no extra cost, preferably w ithin two hours of intimation. Failure to provide a replacement may result in the

Railway arranging alternate transport at the risk and cost of the contractor, in a ddition to deductions/penalties applicable under the GeM Contract/SLA. 15. Change/Replacement of Vehicle or Driver No change of vehicle or driver shall be made without prior approval/intimation a s applicable under the contract, except in an emergency, in which case immedi ate intimation shall be given and a suitable replacement shall be deployed. Rail way Administration may require replacement of any vehicle or driver found uns uitable, unsafe, improperly maintained or unsatisfactory in performance or beh aviour. A driver required to be replaced for unsatisfactory conduct/performance shall be replaced promptly and, wherever specifically required, within 24 hours. 16. Driver Absence In case of absence/leave of the driver, the contractor shall arrange a suitable su bstitute driver having valid credentials so that official work is not affected. The substitute shall comply with all requirements applicable to the original driver. 17. Logbook/Log Sheet A proper daily logbook/log sheet shall be maintained showing date, reporting ti me, release time, opening and closing odometer readings, kilometres run, visite d and certification/signature of the authorized Railway official. Corrections shall be duly authenticated. The certified log sheets shall be submitted with the mont hly bill. The log sheet to be certified by MCTO/GTR. 18. Monthly Bill and Payment Monthly payment shall be processed subject to satisfactory performance, certifi cation by MCTO/GTR, submission of duly certified log sheets and all documents required under the GeM Contract/SLA. Payment shall be regulated strictly accor ding to the accepted GeM Contract/SLA rates and conditions. 19. Penalty and Deductions Any late reporting, absence/non-availability of vehicle or driver, failure to provid e replacement vehicle, breakdown attributable to deficient maintenance, non-c ompliance with instructions or other service deficiency shall attract deductions/ penalties strictly as provided in the GeM Contract/SLA. Such deductions/penaltie s shall be without prejudice to other remedies available to the Railway Administration under the contract and GCC for Services, 2018. 20. Risk and Cost / Alternate Arrangement If the contractor fails to provide the vehicle/service as required, the Railway Ad ministration may, wherever permissible under the applicable contractual provisi

ons, make alternate arrangements at the risk and cost of the contractor. The ex penditure so incurred shall be recoverable from amounts due to the contractor or otherwise in accordance with the contract. 21. Performance Guarantee The successful bidder shall submit Performance Guarantee equivalent to 5% of t he contract value within the prescribed period in accordance with the applicabl e Railway Board instructions and GCC for Services, 2018. Delay in submission s hall attract penal interest/other consequences as applicable under the governin g contractual provisions. 22. Termination / Determination and Forfeiture of Performance Guaran tee In case of persistent or repeated default, non-performance, abandonment of ser vice, repeated non-availability of vehicle/driver, failure to provide replacement vehicle, serious breach of contractual conditions or other defaults covered unde r GCC/GeM Contract, Railway Administration shall be entitled to take action in a ccordance with the applicable provisions of GCC for Services, 2018 and the GeM Contract/SLA, including issuance of performance notice where prescribed, deter mination/termination of the contract, encashment/forfeiture of Performance Gua rantee and arrangement of balance service at the risk and cost of the contractor , as applicable. Termination shall be carried out in accordance with the procedu re and notice requirements prescribed in the governing contract. 23. Contractor's Responsibility and Labour Compliance The contractor shall be solely responsible for payment of wages, statutory bene fits, insurance, compensation and all liabilities relating to the driver/personnel e ngaged by him. The contractor shall comply with all applicable Central Governm ent, State Government, local authority, labour, motor vehicle and other statutor y laws, rules, regulations and notifications. No employer-employee relationship shall exist between Railway Administration and the contractor's personnel. 24. Indemnity and Liability The contractor shall indemnify and keep the Railway Administration indemnified against claims, liabilities, damages, losses, compensation, penalties, legal proce edings and expenses arising from any accident, injury, death, damage to proper ty, negligence, default or act/omission attributable to the contractor, driver or p ersonnel deployed under the contract. 25. Ownership / Lawful Possession

The vehicle shall be owned by the contractor or legally available to the contract or through a valid agreement/authorization. Documentary proof of ownership/la wful possession and authority to deploy the vehicle shall be furnished whenever demanded by Railway Administration. 26. FASTag and GPS The contractor shall ensure that FASTag remains active and adequately recharg ed at all times. Delay or detention due to insufficient FASTag balance shall be th e responsibility of the contractor 27. Unauthorized Use and Security The vehicle shall not be used for unauthorized private or commercial purposes during Railway duty. Unauthorized passengers/materials shall not be carried wh ere such carriage may compromise safety or official functioning. The driver shall not leave the vehicle unattended during duty hours without ensuring its safety and shall not hand over the vehicle keys to any unauthorized person. 28. Inspection and Verification Railway Administration reserves the right to inspect the vehicle, verify statutory documents and driver's credentials and assess the condition, cleanliness, safety and performance of the vehicle at any time during the contract period. 29. Subletting / Assignment The contractor shall not sublet, transfer or assign the whole or any part of the c ontract without prior written approval of Railway Administration, except where s pecifically permitted under the GeM Contract. 30. Authorized Representative The contractor shall nominate an authorized representative with a working mob ile number for coordination and shall ensure immediate response to complaints, breakdowns, replacement requirements and other operational matters. 31. Force Majeure Force Majeure shall be governed by the applicable provisions of GCC for Service s, 2018 and the GeM Contract/SLA. 32. Dispute Resolution and Other Matters Dispute resolution, jurisdiction, notices, modification/variation, contract adminis tration and all other matters not specifically covered in this Scope of Work shall be governed by the GCC for Services, 2018, applicable amendments, GeM Cont ract/SLA and other applicable Railway contractual provisions.

33. No Extra Claim Except for payments expressly admissible under the accepted GeM Contract/SL A, the contractor shall not be entitled to any additional payment on account of f uel price, maintenance, repairs, tyres, batteries, statutory charges, permits, ins urance, or any other cost necessary for performance of the service. 34. Compliance with Instructions The contractor and driver shall strictly comply with lawful instructions issued by Sr DCM/BCT or the authorized Railway official regarding reporting, deployment, route, official movement, safety and operational requirements. Repeated failure to comply with such instructions shall be dealt with under the applicable contra ctual provisions. 35. Final Applicability All conditions contained in this Scope of Work shall be read together with the G CC for Services, 2018, applicable amendments/correction slips, Railway Board i nstructions and the GeM Contract/SLA. In the event of any matter not specificall y provided herein, the applicable provisions of the governing contractual docum ents shall apply. 36. Discontinuity of vehicle The vehicle service may be discontinued intermittently during the contract peri od whenever not opt for/utilize the hired vehicle. No payment shall be admissibl e for the period during which the vehicle service is discontinued. 37. Non-availability of service In case of non-reporting/non-provision of the vehicle on any day, the applicable per-day vehicle hire charges shall be deducted on a pro-rata basis, in addition t o any penalty leviable under the terms and conditions of the contract. .
